nodes.asset_description: A minimalist image shows a large white rounded rectangle centered on a solid black background. The high-contrast, clean design resembles a blank card or UI panel filling most of the frame.

A cartoon-style laboratory beaker is tilted diagonally, half-filled with blue liquid and a few bubbles. The light blue glass has bold black measurement marks and white highlights, set against a transparent background.

A minimalist cartoon of a tilted test tube outlined in black, half-filled with golden-yellow liquid and simple highlight dashes. The glass is a pale cream tone with a rounded rim, set against a transparent/blank background.

A flat, cartoon-style illustration of a battery tilted diagonally, with a pink top half marked with a plus and a yellow bottom half marked with a minus. Clean black outlines and solid colors give it a simple, graphic look.

A cartoon-style eyedropper with a pink rubber bulb and cream tube is tilted diagonally, releasing a blue droplet. The simple vector illustration has clean black outlines, soft shading, and sits isolated on a transparent/black background.

A cartoon-style molecular icon shows a coral-red central sphere with six spokes ending in glossy yellow and orange nodes. The vector graphic has soft highlights and a clean, radial composition on a transparent background.

A cartoon-style illustration of light blue safety goggles with a wraparound lens, bold black outline, and white reflective streaks. A small teal droplet sits on the top bridge, and the goggles are centered on a plain background.
